elaine_cs: Quick update from the onboarding call with Nimbulo — after rotating keys they get short bursts of 429s right after clients start. Handshake logs look OK but calls fail within 10-30s.

devin_sdk: do we have the raw 429 response? is there a Retry-After header or is it an immediate throttle?

elaine_cs: 429s include Retry-After: 1 or sometimes no header. They reported the SDK auto-retries immediately and then gets into a tight loop. Ephemeral tokens TTL is 60s; their webapp opens multiple worker tabs.

jordan_eng: my hypothesis: token leasing + connection budget + parallel preflight fanout. If many tabs do preflight + token fetch simultaneously, we end up hitting per-tenant concurrency limits and short Retry-After/ambiguous headers cause immediate retry storms.

devin_sdk: can you check client config? We recommend limiting concurrent preflights and adding jittered exponential backoff. Example for their integration: ```js
// reduce preflight concurrency + add jitter
const client = new RedwoodSDK({
  maxConcurrentPreflights: 2,
  retry: {
    minDelayMs: 200,
    maxDelayMs: 2500,
    jitter: true,
    maxAttempts: 5
  }
});```

kate_support: If this is blocking them, we can temporarily increase their onboarding quota/burst window while they implement the SDK change. Customer ok with a short bump?

elaine_cs: they said yes to a 2-hour window. Please do not change prod quotas permanently.

onboard-bot: Quota change requested by kate_support for tenant nim-314: +50% burst for 2 hours. (audit-id: q-2026-1767)

jordan_eng: two more checks — 1) clock skew on their CI/edge workers (negative skew makes token immediately expired), 2) token refresh race: if many clients try to refresh the same session at TTL-1, auth service may throttle. We should advise token leashing / leader election on refresh.

elaine_cs: they mentioned some CI runners with skewed NTP, will ask them to sync. Attached log excerpt they pasted here: ```
AUTH_CHECK tenant=nim-314 token_exp=1767001200 now=1767001205 -> rejected
```

devin_sdk: thanks — I'm going to file infra ticket to add a tenant-level metric: `auth.refresh_failures` and `preflight.concurrent_reqs` so we can correlate. I'll reference this thread.

jordan_eng: short-term mitigation guide for them: 1) set maxConcurrentPreflights=2, 2) enable jittered retries, 3) respect Retry-After when present (do not retry before header), 4) implement single-refresh leader for a session in browser tabs.

elaine_cs: I'll send a one-pager to the customer with the config snippet + steps and schedule a 30-min handoff at 11:00am PST tomorrow to watch behaviour.

kate_support: looping in renewal owner if this looks like a risk > moderate. @marcus_sales fyi please — customer is in early onboarding and saw some degraded UX.

marcus_sales: thanks for the heads-up. If the fix takes >24h we'll offer an onboarding engineer session. Keep me posted.

elaine_cs: will do. Action items: kate -> apply temporary quota bump (done), devin -> open infra metric ticket, jordan -> prepare short checklist, me -> send customer guide and run the 11am session.

devin_sdk: ticket created: INF-3421 "tenant nim-314: auth.refresh_failures metric". Adding triage tags.

jordan_eng: adding checklist to our internal KB and will paste link in this thread after it's live.

elaine_cs: thanks all — moving to follow-up.
